title: THE ODDS RECEIPT

win: Your second estimate differed from the alarm number because actual evidence had entered the calculation.

• Look for one missing fact; check the base rate.
• Avoid treating guesses as facts; delay the verdict.
• Question absolute words; use a real example.
• Delay major conclusions when upset; separate possibility from probability.
